claims.short_name: Exhaustive necessary Lovasz cut profiles and unique five-vertex internal block
claims.claim_text: For D=3, alpha=1, beta=2 and at most ten degree-three vertices, all 72 relevant component-size partitions satisfying the numerical necessary cut bounds have unique candidate profile (5,5) with one unit of weighted boundary per component. Every 7-edge simple graph on 5 vertices of degree profile (2,3,3,3,3) is isomorphic to K5 minus a length-two path and a disjoint edge.
claims.support_summary: Exact standalone Python integer partition enumeration over 72 necessary cut profiles; independent exhaustive 1,024 labelled five-vertex graph enumeration finds 30 valid labelled graphs, all of one isomorphism type.

claims.short_name: Only one 16-edge obstruction for the mixed caps 1 and 2
claims.claim_text: Every finite simple graph of maximum degree at most three and exactly sixteen edges failing a (1,2) degree-capped two-colouring is, up to isolated vertices, uniquely the two seven-edge five-vertex blocks sharing a degree-two central attachment vertex.
claims.support_summary: Complete paper deduction from ordinary Lovasz tight-component criterion and earlier subcubic at-least-10-saturated theorem, with parity-forced cut weights, exhausted 10-saturated-size profiles, exact 16-edge budget and block uniqueness. Not full Lean-checked theorem.

claims.short_name: Four further ordered 3-star parameter exclusions via 16-edge core recolouring
claims.claim_text: Conditionally on the admitted paper-level 3x3 joint-residual reduction, the unique 16-edge obstruction can be red/blue coloured so each colour has at most six nonisolated vertices, avoiding every three-positive-star target with largest star ≥2; hence four additional ordered parameter pairs are excluded and the prior 39 method survivors reduce to 35 (18 unordered).
claims.support_summary: Independent exact canonical motif construction and six-vertex-support red/blue colouring; four-case output compared against the SHA-256 pinned 39-case upstream ledger. Original three-star upper/lower formula conditional on the upstream unpromoted paper-level joint-residual theorem.
